card.name: Digits inside long ID numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit (or a dot) in the middle of a long number string, such as a code, section number, NDC, trial ID or URL. It fires on the digit that is followed by more digits.

modes.label: Digit inside a code
modes.description: One digit in the middle of a multi-digit code or identifier, with more digits following.

modes.label: Digit in a URL or catalog number
modes.description: A digit inside a web address, NDC, or trial number.

modes.label: Dot inside a course number
modes.description: A dot inside a course or section number, followed by more digits.

card.plain: It marks a digit in the middle of a long ID or code number, where more digits come next.
